name: Targets Ref
description: The release was cut on this tag ref. Both ends carry the commit they resolved to when observed — `github_release.target_sha` and `git_ref.head_sha` — so a tag moved after the release was cut is a query over two fields, not a diff the collector keeps.

tag_name.description: The tag as the release names it, without the `refs/tags/` prefix — carried so the edge reads without dereferencing the ref.
